$comment: Checked-in project settings for sapui5-validator. Tracked in git (unlike .claude/settings.local.json, which .gitignore excludes) so the guard survives across machines and cycles. The PreToolUse hook runs scripts/guard-precommit.mjs before every Bash/PowerShell command; the guard FAILS OPEN (any error exits 0) and only blocks (exit 2) the cheap test suite run while VALIDATOR_E2E_REAL leaks in the env. See .claude/WORKFLOW.md.
